articles.title: ‘25년 상반기, CJ올리브영 글로벌몰 최대 실적... 매출 70%↑ 주문량 60%↑
CJ올리브영, 미국 첫 오프라인 매장 개점…K뷰티 ‘글로벌 게이트웨이’ 본격 가동
화려하게 미국 데뷔했지만···올리브영, 현지 소비자 눈높이 맞출까

content.excerpt_ko: 2025년 상반기 글로벌몰 매출 70% 증가, 외국인 매출 비중 26% 돌파, 2026년 5~6월 미국 1·2호점 개점. 관광객 쇼핑 거점이던 올리브영이 해외 진출의 관문이 되기까지의 흐름과, 인디 브랜드가 지금 챙겨야 할 점을 정리했습니다.
content.body_ko_html:
무슨 일이 있었나: 2025년 7월부터 2026년 6월까지

2025년 7월, 코스인코리아는 CJ올리브영 글로벌몰이 2025년 상반기에 역대 최대 실적을 냈다고 보도했습니다. 매출은 70%, 주문량은 60% 늘었습니다. 같은 달 연합뉴스는 올리브영의 외국인 매출 비중이 26%를 넘어섰고, 5개월 동안 약 596만 명의 외국인이 구매했다고 전했습니다.

이어 2025년 11월 조선일보가 올리브영의 미국 1호점 개설 계획을 보도했고, 2026년 5월 CJ 뉴스룸은 미국 첫 오프라인 매장 개점을 알리며 K뷰티 '글로벌 게이트웨이'를 본격 가동한다고 밝혔습니다. 2026년 6월 동아일보는 미국 2호점에서도 오픈런이 이어졌고, 프리미엄·글로벌 고객을 겨냥한다고 보도했습니다.

왜 중요한가

흐름을 이어 보면 단계가 분명합니다. 먼저 방한 관광객이 국내 매장에서 K뷰티를 경험하고, 귀국 후에는 글로벌몰로 재구매하며, 마지막으로 현지 오프라인 매장이 이 수요를 받아내는 구조입니다. 올리브영은 국내 유통사를 넘어 인디 브랜드가 해외로 나가는 통로 역할을 키우고 있습니다.

지금도 유효한 점

  • 외국인 매출 비중 26%는 국내 매장 자체가 해외 시장 테스트베드라는 뜻입니다.
  • 글로벌몰 성장(매출 +70%, 주문 +60%)은 관광 이후 재구매 수요가 실재한다는 근거입니다.
  • 다만 시사저널e는 화려한 미국 데뷔 이후 현지 소비자의 눈높이를 맞출 수 있을지를 과제로 짚었습니다. 오픈 초기 열기가 장기 성과로 이어질지는 아직 지켜봐야 합니다.

한 줄 테이크어웨이

올리브영 국내 매장과 글로벌몰에서 외국인 반응을 데이터로 쌓아두는 브랜드가 미국 매장 입점 기회에 가장 먼저 준비된 브랜드가 됩니다.

content.title_en: Global mall sales +70%: can Olive Young win over US shoppers?
content.excerpt_en: From a 70% jump in global mall sales in H1 2025 and foreign shoppers passing 26% of sales, to its first two US stores in May–June 2026: how Olive Young became K-beauty's launchpad abroad, and what buyers should watch.
content.body_en_html:
What happened: July 2025 to June 2026

In July 2025, Cosinkorea reported that CJ Olive Young's global online mall posted its best-ever first half in 2025, with sales up 70% and order volume up 60%. The same month, Yonhap reported that foreign customers had passed 26% of Olive Young's sales, with roughly 5.96 million foreign shoppers making purchases over five months.

In November 2025, the Chosun Ilbo reported that Olive Young would open its first US store. In May 2026, CJ Newsroom announced the opening of its first US brick-and-mortar store, framing it as the start of a K-beauty "global gateway." In June 2026, the Dong-A Ilbo reported that the second US store also drew opening-day lines, targeting premium and global customers.

Why it matters

The sequence is clear: tourists discover K-beauty in Olive Young's Korean stores, reorder through the global mall once home, and are now met by physical stores abroad. Olive Young is turning from a domestic retailer into a scaling channel for indie Korean brands.

What still holds today

  • A 26%+ foreign sales share makes Olive Young's Korean stores a live test market for international demand.
  • Global mall growth (+70% sales, +60% orders) signals real post-trip repurchase demand.
  • Sisa Journal-e asked whether Olive Young can meet local US shoppers' expectations after its splashy debut. Whether launch buzz becomes lasting traffic is still an open question.

One takeaway

For global buyers, Olive Young's bestseller and foreign-shopper data is an early signal of which Korean brands are ready to travel; the US stores will show which ones actually convert with local customers.

Sources: Cosinkorea, Yonhap News, Chosun Ilbo, CJ Newsroom, Dong-A Ilbo, Sisa Journal-e

Written with the help of AI.
content.linkedin_en:
Olive Young's global mall grew sales 70% in H1 2025. A year later, it was running two stores in the US.

A quick archive recap for anyone sourcing K-beauty:

- July 2025 (Cosinkorea): global mall sales +70%, orders +60% in the first half.
- July 2025 (Yonhap): foreign shoppers passed 26% of Olive Young's sales, with about 5.96 million foreign buyers over five months.
- May 2026 (CJ Newsroom): first US brick-and-mortar store opened, pitched as a K-beauty "global gateway."
- June 2026 (Dong-A Ilbo): the second US store also drew opening-day lines.

The open question, raised by Sisa Journal-e: can a retailer built on tourist demand meet the expectations of everyday US shoppers?

For buyers and retailers, the takeaway is practical. Olive Young's foreign-shopper bestsellers are an early read on which Korean brands travel well. Its US stores will now show which ones convert locally. Worth tracking both before your next assortment review.

Sources: Cosinkorea, Yonhap, Chosun Ilbo, CJ Newsroom, Dong-A Ilbo, Sisa Journal-e. Written with the help of AI.

cover.sub: Olive Young, from global mall to US stores

slides.headline: Global mall sales up 70%
slides.what: In H1 2025, Olive Young's global online mall grew sales 70% and orders 60% (reported July 2025).
slides.why: It shows real repurchase demand from overseas shoppers after they return home.
slides.action: Use Olive Young global mall bestsellers as an early filter when scouting Korean brands.

slides.headline: Foreign shoppers pass 26% of sales
slides.what: About 5.96 million foreign shoppers bought at Olive Young over five months, per a July 2025 report.
slides.why: Olive Young's Korean stores work as a live test market for international demand.
slides.action: Ask suppliers for their Olive Young foreign-shopper sales data before you list them.

slides.headline: Two US stores, two opening-day lines
slides.what: Olive Young opened its first US store in May 2026; the second drew lines in June 2026.
slides.why: It links tourist and online demand to physical retail in the US market.
slides.action: Track which brands lead in Olive Young US stores to benchmark your own K-beauty shelf.

slides.headline: The real test: local expectations
slides.what: Sisa Journal-e questioned whether Olive Young can meet US shoppers' expectations post-debut.
slides.why: Popularity with tourists does not guarantee everyday demand from local US customers.
slides.action: Judge K-beauty lines on US reviews and price fit, not on launch buzz alone.
